The district is bordered on the southwest by Thanh Xuan district, the south by Hoang Mai district, and the north by Hoan Kiem district. Create necessary road circuits to connect the district's economic zone with neighboring districts. Nguyen Du, Le Dai Hanh, Bui Thi Xuan, Pho Hue, Ngo Thi Nham, Pham Dinh Ho, Dong Nhan, Dong Mac, Bach Dang, Thanh Luong, Thanh Nhan, Cau Den, Bach Khoa, Quynh Loi, Bach Mai, Quynh Mai, Vinh Tuy, Minh Khai, Truong Dinh, Dong Tam are among the district's 20 wards. Because this is also the southern entrance to the old Thang Long citadel, historical remains such as Kim Lien cell near the intersection of Kim Lien intersection Dai Co Viet street, Cau Den square, can still be seen. Today, the Thinh Yen cell is located around the junction of Hue street and Bach Mai street, while the Dong Mac street, also known as the Luong Yen street, is located near the intersection of Lo Duc street and Tran Khat Chan street. Roads in Hai Ba Trung district The district's principal roadways, such as the Nguyen Khoai axis near the Red River dike, the Tran Khat Chan - Dai Co Viet axis, the Vinh Tuy, Minh Khai, and Truong Dinh axes, are broad and separated into lanes, near a large bridge, such as the Vinh Tuy Bridge. The operation of Vinh Tuy Bridge helps to decrease the distance between Hanoi and adjacent cities along Highway 5 between Hai Phong and Quang Ninh. This is also the bridge that connects Hai Ba Trung and Long Bien districts across the Red River. Many routes in the area are currently being re-planned, and the number of vehicles moving is fairly high, as are the number of bus stops, including Thong Nhat Park, which offers bus routes 11 to Ho Chi Minh City. Bus 40 to Van Lam Hung Yen, bus 43 to Dong Anh Hanoi, bus 52A to Le Chi region Gia Lam bordering Bac Ninh province. Buses in the Times City luxury urban area (such as bus 45, 55A, and CNG 03 - a clean fuel-powered vehicle), and a bus stop near the National Economics University (such as bus number 18, bus No. 47B). Line 23 of Nguyen Cong Tru, route 31 of the University of Science and Technology... The Kim Lien tunnel and other overpass routes in the VinCity help to alleviate traffic congestion on important roadways. Near bus terminals, there is a North-South railway that connects provinces in the northern and center areas. Trees and lake system in Hai Ba Trung district The district's roadways are completely green, with the exception of those around the lake, dorms, and schools. Many ancient trees line the narrow lanes that flank the Hoan Kiem area, the majority of which are mother of pearl, phoenix, and milkweed trees. Especially along the Nguyen Du road, which has more than a kilometer of fall milkweed trees. The district area encompasses the majority of Thong Nhat Park; the park is in a great location in the center of the inner city districts, which has Bay Mau lake, and the venue's rental revenue is a significant source of revenue for Thong Nhat Park. The park is an expensive outdoor event place since it is about 50 hectares broad, has the largest lake in the vicinity, the scenery is full of trees, and there is a lot of unoccupied ground. Small islands of peace and unity may be seen in the neighborhood, as well as attractively adorned miniatures on campus. Between the current rapidly increasing population density and lakes such as Hai Ba Trung lake in Huong Vien street, Dong Nhan ward, right near Hai Ba Trung temple, and Thien Quang lake in Huong Vien street, Dong Nhan ward, right near Hai Ba Trung temple, the district also has lakes that regulate the landscape and air. The Hanoi People's Committee also released the white and black swans from Belgium on an area of roughly 1.1ha. Quynh lake is 0.7 hectares in size and is located near Thanh Nhan Lake, which is 7.6 hectares in size, all of which contribute to the district being greener and cleaner. Architecture in Hai Ba Trung district Reunification Park, Reunification Island, and Peace Island are all part of the Hai Ba Trung District's Reunification Park. White swans may be found in Hai Ba Trung, Thanh Nhan, Quynh, and Thien Quang lakes. Hai Ba Trung's architecture is a mix of old and new. The preceding period's home rows have been preserved, as have the sceneries of the village gate, which are remnants of historic architecture. However, the density of relics is fairly high, giving the district's people a significant spiritual value. Ho Quoc Pagoda, Lien Phai Pagoda, Chan Tien Pagoda, Duc Vien Pagoda, Dong Nhan Temple, Thien Quang Pagoda, King Pagoda, Thanh Nhan Pagoda... are only a few of the outstanding works here. Lien Pagoda was the ancestral home of the Lien Tong sect (Hoa Sen lineage), one of our country's Zen Buddhist sects, which first arose towards the end of the Later Le Dynasty (17th-18th centuries). The pagoda's construction includes a five-story Cuu Sinh burial tower, which is almost 300 years old. This is the oldest tower in Hanoi's ancient city center. The three temples of Quang Hoa, Thien Quang, and Phap Hoa are renowned as a sacred Buddhist temple, a religious architectural complex, and are located on a tiny peninsula in the west of Thien Quang lake. Beautiful and one of a kind. In 1989, the relic cluster Thien Quang - Quang Hoa - Phap Hoa was designated as a scenic relic. Dong Nhan Temple, located at 12 Huong Vien Street in Dong Nhan Ward, Hai Ba Trung District, Hanoi City, worships Hai Ba Trung. This location has been the most revered Hai Ba Trung temple in Thang Long's capital for many generations. During commerce, there are markets such as Cho Hom and Cho Mo. The architecture of Cho Mo has been renovated and modified several times. Until now, there have been three market bridges with brick columns and tiled roofs, but no corrugated iron or flat roofs, no iron trusses. The layout of the market is a little metropolitan, yet Mo mart contains adequate everyday necessities. Apart from maintaining the old beauty, the architecture here focuses on the creation of future infrastructure, such as flats and new high-rise structures. Population and Housing in Hai Ba Trung district Unequal educational levels are mostly seen in lecturer dormitories at prominent institutions such as the University of Science and Technology, the University of Civil Engineering, and the National Economics University. On Minh Khai Street, high-end apartment buildings such as Times City and Imperia Sky Garden Apartment are located in a great position. Sky Light apartment 125D Minh Khai, Hoa Binh Green City apartment, Thang Long Garden apartment 250 Minh Khai are some of the other high-end properties available. The population density in the district is relatively high, with over 30,741 persons per square kilometer. The population is centered on high-end apartment complexes close to schools and hospitals such as Huu Nghi Hospital and 108 Hospital. The city's spiritual life is also rather vibrant, and the entire TimesCity high-class metropolitan area offers a comprehensive range of amenities, including shops, schools, hospitals, and amusement parks. There are handy roadways around the neighborhood that connect to nearby areas, such as the Vinh Tuy bridge. International schools in the area are Winston International School, Flying Kites Montessori Preschool or Sakura Montessori Kindergarten that all have been gaining a lot of trust from both foreign and Vietnamese parents. University of Economics - Industrial Technology, University of Science and Technology, University of Construction, National Economics University, and University Institute are just a few of the colleges and institutions in the area. Open Hanoi, Oriental Private University, and Hanoi University of Business and Technology are some of the universities in Hanoi. Thang Long High School, Tran Nhan Tong High School, Hai Ba Trung High School, Vinschool High School, Hong Ha Private School, and Hoang Dieu School are part of the high school system. There are about 15 secondary schools in the district. There are numerous companies and businesses of the central government and the city near the residential neighborhood, such as Dong Xuan knitwear, Ha Noi Pha Den port, Minh Khai - Vinh Tuy industrial cluster, and others, which provide good economic circumstances. of the district is increasing at a rapid pace. Along with this, there has been a significant resurrection of real estate developments on golden land in certain district regions, particularly on Minh Khai street.
